components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--raised); color: var(--fg); padding: 0.625rem 1rem; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 6px; transition: background 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--over); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--live); outline-offset: 2px; }
components.description: Most important action on an Operate screen. Greyscale, one luminance step on hover.
components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-hero { background: var(--over); color: var(--fg); padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 6px; transition: background 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-hero:hover { background: var(--rule); } .ds-btn-hero:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--live); outline-offset: 2px; }
components.description: Single action on Persuade surfaces. One step above Primary.
components.name: Hero Button

components.css: .ds-code { background: var(--canvas); color: var(--fg-2); border: 1px solid var(--hair); border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.875rem; font-family: var(--font-geist-mono), ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.72; } .ds-code .k { color: var(--code-green); font-weight: 600; } .ds-code .s { color: var(--code-orange); }
components.description: Code on the reading ground inside one hairline. Only place syntax colour appears.
components.name: Code Block

components.css: .ds-field { background: var(--canvas); color: var(--fg); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem; font-size: 0.8125rem; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--live); outline-offset: 2px; background: var(--raised); }
components.description: Composer and palette input. Steps up on focus.
components.name: Field

components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.75rem 1.25rem 1fr; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.22rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 3px; color: var(--fg-2); font-size: 0.8125rem; } .ds-row:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--raised) 60%, transparent); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--live); outline-offset: 2px; }
components.description: Outline rail row. Mark, number, title. Open state uses raised ground.
components.name: Outline Row

motion.name: ease-expo
motion.purpose: Only easing. Row changes 120ms, default 160ms, entrances 240ms. Done handoff is the one authored moment.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Only shadow. Command palette and Select popup.

body.purpose: Lesson prose at 1rem/1.72 on a 36rem measure.

label.purpose: One uppercase tracked style for names, not reading.

mono.purpose: Code, tables, and numbers that are data.

dos: Do separate surfaces with luminance and hairlines, except the single enclosure around code.
Do spend live olive outside code on exactly the Lesson you are up to.
Do keep every text step at 4.5:1 or better on all four surfaces.
Do keep syntax colour inside code blocks on the reading ground.
donts: Don't build cards as page structure.
Don't spend the accent on done, hover, buttons, or anything but the live Lesson outside code.
Don't set any part of the product in a serif.
Don't copy direction contracts into shipped markup.
Don't add radius outside the 3/6/10px ramp.
keyCharacteristics: Two warm grounds, one system, zero cards as page structure, one shadow, one grain wash.
One accent with one meaning outside code. Code alone carries syntax colour.
Fewest facts per row. Geist and Geist Mono only. 36rem measure.
narrative.overview: A warm desk for structured courses. Order comes from ink and spacing. Chrome stays restrained while code carries disciplined syntax colour. Grain adds tooth without costing long-session comfort.

rules.body: Olive means exactly one thing outside code: the Lesson you are up to. Syntax roles never leak out.
rules.name: The One Accent Rule

rules.body: Surfaces separate by luminance. The one exception is code on its reading ground inside a single hairline.
rules.name: The Light, Not Line Rule

rules.body: Where you are up to is colour; what you have open is light. The two never swap.
rules.name: The Two Signals Rule

rules.body: Direction contracts live in surface briefs, never in shipped markup.
rules.name: The No Contract In Markup Rule
